navSub: Where the group ride or race will split
title: Crosswind and echelons: see where the race will split
description: Echelon Analysis scores the crosswind risk of every sector of your route with surface-aware physics and land-use data – so you know where the group will split.
intro: In a crosswind the bunch splits into echelons – and whoever is at the back of the wrong one is gone. Echelon Analysis shows you before the start which sectors are exposed, how strong the split risk is and where you need to be at the front.
ctaLabel: Analyse a route in the web app

hero.mainAlt: Echelon Analysis: critical sections, high-risk distance and max split risk, with the route mapped by split risk

howImageAlt: Wind Flow Map with crosswind sections in yellow

how.title: Sector by sector
how.text: Your route is split into sectors. For each one, {name} combines wind speed, wind angle and gusts at the time the group gets there.

how.title: Surface-aware physics
how.text: Open fields, forest or town: CORINE and OpenStreetMap land-use data show how sheltered each sector is – a crosswind behind a tree line is not a crosswind on open farmland.

how.title: Know where to be at the front
how.text: Critical sections, high-risk distance and maximum split risk at a glance – for races, group rides and triathlon bike courses.
